how do I cite papers here?
I’ll check the bibliography file and existing citation examples, then show the exact pattern.

Add the paper’s BibTeX record to [`hivatkozasok.bib`](/codex_workspace/6f95d2c9-2a91-402a-ac8a-9b0d861061ea/hivatkozasok.bib:1), then cite its key in the text of [`contents/5-elozmenyek.tex`](/codex_workspace/6f95d2c9-2a91-402a-ac8a-9b0d861061ea/contents/5-elozmenyek.tex:1). For example, if the record starts with `@article{dietai24, ...}`, write `\cite{dietai24}` where you discuss the paper. The key must match exactly.

This project uses IEEE-style citations and already has an example in [`contents/7-eredmenyek.tex`](/codex_workspace/6f95d2c9-2a91-402a-ac8a-9b0d861061ea/contents/7-eredmenyek.tex:59). The cited paper will appear in the bibliography when you compile; `latexmk` runs Biber as part of the build.
